meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: Decision guide for delegating to caveman-style subagents. Tells the main thread WHEN to spawn `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit), or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of doing the work inline or using vanilla `Explore`. Subagent output is caveman-compressed so the tool-result injected back into main context is ~60% smaller — main context lasts longer across long sessions. Trigger: "delegate to subagent", "use cavecrew", "spawn investigator/builder/reviewer", "save context", "compressed agent output".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用压缩子代理输出节省主上下文空间
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在长会话中通过子代理节省上下文空间。
copy.tagline_en: Save main context with compressed subagent output
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to preserve context in long sessions by delegating to subagents.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用三个子代理（investigator、builder、reviewer）来执行代码定位、编辑和审查任务。子代理的输出经过压缩，比普通方式节省约60%的上下文空间，让对话会话更持久。
howto.when: 当你提到“委托给子代理”、“使用cavecrew”、“生成investigator/builder/reviewer”、“节省上下文”、“压缩代理输出”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用cavecrew-investigator查找函数X的定义位置。
say.note: 子代理返回压缩的代码位置列表。
子代理执行精确编辑并验证。
子代理返回问题列表和修复建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses three subagents (investigator, builder, reviewer) for code locating, editing, and reviewing. Their output is compressed, saving ~60% context space compared to normal methods, making long sessions last longer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "delegate to subagent", "use cavecrew", "spawn investigator/builder/reviewer", "save context", or "compressed agent output".

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-investigator to find where function X is defined.
say_en.note: Subagent returns a compressed list of code locations.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-builder to edit line 10 of file A.
say_en.note: Subagent performs precise edit and verifies.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-reviewer to review the current diff.
say_en.note: Subagent returns issues and fix suggestions.
